# Elevate Digitals — Full Business Profile

## About
Elevate Digitals is a South African web design agency that builds modern,
professional websites for small businesses, startups, and entrepreneurs.
We specialise in fast turnaround (2 weeks), transparent pricing, and
ongoing monthly maintenance so clients never have to worry about the
technical side of running a website.

## Services in Detail

### Website Design & Build
We design and build custom websites from scratch or redesign outdated sites.
Every website is mobile-responsive, SEO-optimised, and built for speed.
Includes custom design, contact forms, WhatsApp integration, and Google Maps.

### Monthly Maintenance
We keep your website secure, updated, and running perfectly every month.
Includes security patches, plugin updates, performance monitoring,
content updates, and uptime guarantees.

## Full Pricing

### Website Packages
| Package  | Price     | Pages     | Best For                          |
|----------|-----------|-----------|-----------------------------------|
| Starter  | R5,500    | 1-3 pages | Small businesses getting online   |
| Business | R9,500    | 5-7 pages | Businesses wanting to attract clients |
| Pro      | R14,500   | 10 pages  | Businesses looking to scale       |
| Premium  | R19,500+  | Custom    | Advanced or custom requirements   |

## Service Area
Elevate Digitals serves clients across all of South Africa, operating
primarily online with the ability to work with any business nationally.
